title: Choose outsourcing in the character wizard and verify the saved character profile

steps.description: Read authoritative player profile after the real eight-step creation flow
The selected sect is committed to the formal profile
Read the sects available to new employees
The employment list exposes all eight configured sect employers
The home character card exposes its real sect navigation control
Open the sect page from the home character card
The real sect page renders the available workplace cards
Return through the normal navigation to inspect after-work life
Read all authoritative daily life choices
All twelve activities are backed by the life service
Scroll the home column to its lower content until the after-work life control is visible before clicking it
Confirm the after-work life control is now inside the viewport and can receive input
Open the playable after-work life menu from the home screen
The modal presents the full life activity menu
Scroll the life-menu card to its later activities using the real modal scroll container
Long-form activities are reachable in the scrollable life menu

steps.name: sect-after-work-life-menu
steps.description: Capture the complete after-work life menu
